name: Wiki Viewer
description: Read-only: rebuilds an Obsidian-style single-file snapshot of the wiki (tree, search, backlinks, graph) and opens it in the browser, optionally at a specific note.

capabilities: open wiki in browser at a specific note

tooling._note: Moved from ~/Workspaces/max/scripts/wiki-viewer/ (max@6b60599) on 2026-09-24. Output is outside all repos because it embeds the full wiki.

context_buckets._note: Only for RAG buckets (FTS5 / pgvector). Curated knowledge lives in wiki_access.

trigger.description: "open my wiki", "show me the wiki graph", "open the <note> page"
